name: Higgsfield CLI
desc: Generates images and video from the terminal or coding agents
desc_zh: 在终端或编程智能体里生成图片和视频的命令行工具
solves: Adding a generated asset to a build meant a browser detour; call Higgsfield from a script or agent instead.
solves_zh: 给项目加一张生成素材要专门开浏览器；现在脚本或编程智能体直接调用。
best_for: A docs site needs forty consistent illustrations before the release; script them through the CLI overnight.
best_for_zh: 文档站在发版前要四十张风格一致的插图；写个脚本，用 CLI 一晚上批量生成。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — https://higgsfield.ai/creator-hub/changelog (entry 'Higgsfield CLI')）。 Released three days before the window opens; included because it is absent from the ledger. 首次公开日期来源：https://higgsfield.ai/creator-hub/changelog
